jobPostingInfo.title: Data Scientist
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
About the role

Build models that help people move.

Requirements

  • 5+ years applying data science or machine learning
  • Python and SQL in production
  • Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud warehouse
  • Experimentation (A/B testing) and clear communication

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States.

In California, New York, and Washington the standard base pay range for this role is $125,900.00 - $201,100.00 annually.
